facts: Bryan County, Oklahoma commissioners enacted a one-year moratorium on data center development effective Sept. 30, 2026, lasting 365 days unless changed or ended early.
The moratorium was prompted by concern over a possible data center within a mile of a school southeast of Caddo.
The resolution was modeled on ones from Tulsa County and Choctaw counties.
The county will research and consult with the district attorney during the pause.
Choctaw County commissioners adopted a one-year moratorium on data centers, server farms and other tech facilities in May 2026
Residents passed a petition at the Boswell town hall in opposition to the project
Eastman cited a facility using 1.1 billion gallons of water a year through open evaporative cooling
